hey....

  ( i don't know if this picture works, but if it does. thats me ^.^ )
I'm peaches_lovebird but you can call me Sam. Some of you WTF (Way Too Fabulous) people may know me from in-game. I love commentating Nebula games with my friends that include; jakesandobal, DarkArcher, jozzmcozz, hamsterr, BigSock, Aadie and lots of other amazing people! I love talking to people so don't be hesitant at all to talk to me :)
Cats are my favorite thing in the world as well as apple pie

Luv ya <3
